overview_description.description:
Zebrium uses unsupervised machine learning to automatically catch software incidents and show you root cause. Our technology works by finding hotspots of abnormally correlated anomalous patterns across logs and metrics. You can get started for free by visiting www.zebrium.com.

It was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

product.name: Root Cause as a Service (RCaaS)
product.description: A service that uses machine learning to automatically identify the root cause of software incidents by analyzing logs, eliminating the need for manual log searching.

product.name: ML for Logs
product.description: A machine learning-based tool that ingests and categorizes logs, detects patterns and anomalies, and generates root cause reports with plain language summaries.

product.name: Zebrium + Datadog Integration
product.description: An integration that allows Zebrium's root cause indicators to appear directly on Datadog dashboards, automating the identification of root causes from logs.

product.name: Zebrium + New Relic Integration
product.description: An integration that enables automatic root cause detection in logs within New Relic dashboards, eliminating the need for manual log analysis.

product.name: Zebrium + AppDynamics Integration
product.description: An integration that uses machine learning to find root causes in logs when AppDynamics detects an event, providing concise root cause reports.
